title: Lifecycle Mark Extrema: Session Clock versus Elapsed Duration

research_height.transfer_path: Lifecycle peak/trough timing identifies whether mark opportunity is organized by a shared market-session clock or by time since each component's entry; that distinction changes which causal variable future portfolio construction would need to preserve.

central_question: Across all six current components, are lifecycle peak and trough marks jointly more concentrated and more cross-component-aligned in server wall-clock time than in elapsed time since entry?

research_bundle.name: peak_clock_concentration_trough_natural_contrast_and_cross_component_jsd
lenses: value-production lens: pooled peak-mark wall-clock versus elapsed-time concentration on identical 30-minute supports
adverse-path natural contrast: the same frozen comparison for trough marks
mechanism and falsification: mean pairwise Jensen-Shannon divergence of the six component histograms under wall-clock versus elapsed coordinates

frozen_lifecycle_and_time_semantics.population: Use event=CLOSE rows only. Pair each to exactly one BIRTH row by component_id plus position_identifier and require identical entry_time_server.
frozen_lifecycle_and_time_semantics.final_time: The CLOSE row server_time is the lifecycle terminal time regardless of native or external exit detail.
frozen_lifecycle_and_time_semantics.extrema_integrity: Require entry_time_server <= peak_time_server <= final server_time and entry_time_server <= trough_time_server <= final server_time, strictly positive mark_samples, partial_observation=0 and research_dropped_records=0.
frozen_lifecycle_and_time_semantics.maximum_span: Both peak and trough elapsed minutes must be in [0,1440); any lifecycle outside the common 24-hour support invalidates the unit.
frozen_lifecycle_and_time_semantics.wall_coordinate: Minute of server day including seconds as a fractional minute, modulo 1,440.
frozen_lifecycle_and_time_semantics.elapsed_coordinate: Exact elapsed minutes from entry_time_server to the extremum.
frozen_lifecycle_and_time_semantics.binning: For both coordinates use floor(minutes/30), yielding the identical fixed support bins 0 through 47. Do not rebin after outcomes.

frozen_metrics.pooled_hhi: For peak and trough separately and each coordinate, sum squared pooled bin shares over all 48 bins.
frozen_metrics.pooled_top_bin_share: Maximum pooled bin share; ties report the earliest numeric bin without changing any metric.
frozen_metrics.component_histograms: For each extremum and coordinate, create one 48-bin probability vector per component using all of its required rows.
frozen_metrics.pairwise_jsd: For every one of the 15 component pairs, calculate base-2 Jensen-Shannon divergence between their vectors, with zero-probability terms contributing zero. Report the unweighted mean of 15 divergences.
frozen_metrics.coordinate_interpretation: Higher pooled HHI means stronger shared concentration. Lower mean pairwise JSD means the six components align more closely under that coordinate.

requirements: All seven byte/hash pins and prior verdict/source anchors pass.
The lifecycle ledger has exactly 841 unique rows: 356 BIRTH, 356 CLOSE and 129 FIRST_PEER_NATURAL_EXIT.
Exactly 356 one-to-one BIRTH/CLOSE pairs satisfy every extrema, span, mark-sample, partial and dropped-record requirement.
The six CLOSE counts are exactly 44, 32, 129, 28, 31 and 92, so every component has at least 25 observations.
All four 48-bin histograms per component sum to one within 1e-12 and all 15 pairwise divergences are finite in [0,1].

per_extremum_requirements: wall-clock pooled HHI minus elapsed-time pooled HHI is at least 0.03
wall-clock pooled top-bin share minus elapsed-time pooled top-bin share is at least 0.05
mean wall-clock pairwise JSD is at most 0.75 times mean elapsed-time pairwise JSD
fixed_session_anchor_gate.complete_requirement: Every per-extremum requirement must pass independently for both peak and trough.

per_extremum_requirements: elapsed-time pooled HHI minus wall-clock pooled HHI is at least 0.03
elapsed-time pooled top-bin share minus wall-clock pooled top-bin share is at least 0.05
mean elapsed-time pairwise JSD is at most 0.75 times mean wall-clock pairwise JSD
fixed_duration_anchor_falsifier.trigger_requirement: Every per-extremum requirement must pass independently for both peak and trough.
